title: Taramyn Barcona
description: Taramyn Barcona was on the Aldhani team led by Vel Sartha. He was a former Stormtrooper, which gave him insight into Imperial operations. He was crucial to planning the heist, teaching the team how to march like Imperials. During the heist, Sartha was pinned down and Barcona went to her aid. Barcona was dropped by blaster fire, but Sartha did escape.
